done.what: Plain path:line[:col], path(line,col) and Python 'File "x", line N' text becomes a link only if the file exists, looked up from the shell's reported working directory (OSC 7 / 9;9, read ahead of the parser in term.rs) or else the session's start directory (journal header). Network paths are never looked up. Plain http(s) addresses too, ending before sentence punctuation.

Sound follows the default output device at once (issue #8): IMMNotificationClient registered on the sound thread; the callback sets an atomic flag and on its rising edge try_sends one message (no polling); the sound thread reopens the new default paused. Bursts are coalesced by the default device id, so a spread-out burst costs one reopen.

Reduced motion (issue #9): SPI_GETCLIENTAREAANIMATION read at start and on WM_SETTINGCHANGE (window procedure subclassed). With animations off the reveal is instant, the light field stays dark, the cursor neither glides nor flares and the World view does not unfold; switching it on mid-reveal settles on the next frame. PROTEUS_MOTION=still|full overrides.

path:line precision on a recorded compiler and test-output corpus (roadmap 14: >= 99%) is not measured: no corpus was recorded in this lane.
Link targets are not returned through lean reads (roadmap 14, last clause).

A Ctrl+click on a link while a program has mouse reporting on opens the link and the program sees neither press nor release; a program that wants Ctrl+click itself on a link cell does not get it (on plain text it does).

A plain path anywhere on this computer that exists becomes a link (absolute paths from compilers are the common case); files outside the working directory are not refused, only shown by full path in the strip. Programs are never run.
The device-follow callback also does a non-blocking try_send to wake the sound thread (more than 'set a flag and nothing else'); the alternative is polling.
A default-output change while a sound is playing cuts that sound: the stream is reopened paused at once. Not exercised by a test (it would need audible output).
proteus shot does not read PROTEUS_MOTION or the system setting (screenshots stay machine-independent); --flash has its own --still.
Hover rechecks the link under a resting pointer on every frame that rebuilt the grid (full-grid scan for OSC 8, one file lookup for plain paths); not measured under flood.
